title: 听力挑战 · 懊悔与愿望

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: I really wish I had started learning English much earlier.
rounds.lineCn: 我真希望我早一点开始学英语。

grammar.name: wish + 过去完成式
grammar.note: 对过去事实的遗憾用 wish + had done,表示'但愿当时……'。

options.text: It is never too late to begin.
options.feedback: 安慰鼓励对方,回应遗憾心情得体。
与'希望早学'的遗憾矛盾,事实不符。
谈自己的计划,没有回应对方的懊悔。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: If only I had kept my old job at the bank that year.
rounds.lineCn: 要是那年我留在银行的工作就好了。

grammar.name: If only 虚拟语气
grammar.note: If only 后接 had done 表达对过去未能实现的愿望的强烈遗憾。

options.text: You made a brave choice back then.
options.feedback: 肯定对方当年的决定,安慰自然得体。
与辞职的遗憾事实矛盾,时态混乱。

options.text: Your old job is in the north.
options.feedback: 谈工作的地理位置,没有回应心情。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: I wish I could speak French as well as you.
rounds.lineCn: 我希望能像你一样把法语说得那么好。

grammar.name: wish + could 表愿望
grammar.note: wish + could do 表达对现在状况的虚拟愿望。

options.text: You can start with simple words and build up.
options.feedback: 给出可行建议,鼓励对方学习法语。

options.text: You spoke French well last month.
options.feedback: 与'现在还不会'的愿望矛盾。
陈述法语的使用地区,没有回应愿望。
